answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 62736 Country: India Title: Replying to Salam Question: We don't reply/give Salam during Namaz. What are the other activities when we should not give/reply to Salam? Answer ID: 62736 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 150/150/M=02/1437) One should not greet a person who is busy in salah, khutbah, tilawat, dhikr, or eating food or morsel is in his mouth or defecates or is busy in azan, iqamah, dua etc. If someone greets him, then it is not wajib for him to respond. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
